text:
UNIVERSITY EXAMINATION BRANCH
Notification dated 12/11/2026

Students appearing for the End Semester Examinations (December 2026) shall pay the examination fee on or before 25-11-2026. Fee with a late fine of Rs. 500 can be paid up to 30-11-2026. The examinations will commence on 14-12-2026 and end on 24-12-2026. Hall tickets will be released on 08-12-2026.
